title: Laredo Police Department Shares Thanksgiving Video Greeting
excerpt: The Laredo Police Department shared a Thanksgiving video greeting on Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026, thanking the community it serves and wishing Laredo families a happy holiday.
content:
The Laredo Police Department shared a Thanksgiving video greeting on Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026.

In the greeting, the department said it is thankful for the opportunity to serve, protect, and make a difference in the community it proudly calls home.

The department wished Laredo families a Happy Thanksgiving filled with love, joy, and blessings.
